zh.title: 空客A320neo HS-CBE抵達高雄國際機場
zh.summary: 本站監測系統確認註冊號HS-CBE的空客A320neo於2026年8月8日晚間抵達高雄國際機場。
body: 本站監測系統於2026年8月8日觀測到註冊號為HS-CBE的空客A320neo（ICAO機型A20N）以呼號AIQ234抵達高雄國際機場（ICAO RCKH）。
根據公開ADS-B觀測資料，該航班的首次有效觀測時間為2026-08-08T22:55:58Z，確認抵達時間為2026-08-08T23:47:26Z。
抵達判定為confirmed_arrival，依據是位於機場地理圍欄內且alt_baro為ground。
有效觀測筆數為2，系統觀測歷史累積中尚無可比較的長期統計。
營運者名稱未識別，營運者ICAO為AIQ，航空器ICAO hex為880c45。

en.title: Airbus A320neo HS-CBE Arrives at Kaohsiung International Airport
en.summary: The site's ADS-B observation confirms that Airbus A320neo registration HS-CBE arrived at Kaohsiung International Airport on 8 August 2026.
body: The observation system recorded registration HS-CBE, an Airbus A320neo (ICAO type A20N) with callsign AIQ234, arriving at Kaohsiung International Airport (ICAO RCKH).
The first valid observation timestamp was 2026-08-08T22:55:58Z and the confirmed arrival time was 2026-08-08T23:47:26Z.
Arrival status is confirmed_arrival based on being inside the airport geofence with barometric altitude on ground.
There were two valid observation samples; the site's historical record shows no comparable long-term statistics for this combination.
Operator name is unidentified, operator ICAO is AIQ, and the aircraft ICAO hex is 880c45.

sources.name: Airplanes.live — 公開 ADS-B 觀測：A20N 抵達 高雄國際機場

facts.claim: Registration HS-CBE of an Airbus A320neo arrived at Kaohsiung International Airport.
The aircraft type is Airbus A320neo (ICAO A20N).
Arrival status confirmed based on geofence and ground altitude.
